**Pipeline controller notification**
This repo is configured to use the [pipeline controller](https://docs.ci.openshift.org/how-tos/creating-a-pipeline/). Second-stage tests will be triggered either automatically or after lgtm label is added, depending on the repository configuration. The pipeline controller will automatically detect which contexts are required and will utilize `/test` Prow commands to trigger the second stage.

For optional jobs, comment `/test ?` to see a list of all defined jobs. To trigger manually all jobs from second stage use `/pipeline required` command. 

This repository is configured in: LGTM mode

## Walkthrough MachineSet and ControlPlaneMachineSet now expose OS stream values with an RHEL9 fallback. Stream values flow through RHCOS image metadata lookup and platform handlers, while the vSphere backdated boot-image path supplies the RHEL9 stream explicitly. ### Changes **OS stream image resolution** |Layer / File(s)|Summary| |---|---| |**OS stream accessors**
`test/extended-priv/controlplanemachineset.go`, `test/extended-priv/machineset.go`|ControlPlaneMachineSet and MachineSet read the OS stream label and fall back to `OSImageStreamRHEL9` when unavailable or empty.| |**Stream-aware RHCOS handlers**
`test/extended-priv/mco_scale.go`|RHCOS handler contracts and AWS, GCP, and vSphere implementations accept the stream and use stream-aware image metadata lookup URLs.| |**Stream propagation to image callers**
`test/extended-priv/mco_scale.go`, `test/extended-priv/mco_bootimages.go`|MachineSet cloning passes its OS stream to base-image lookups, and the vSphere backdated boot-image path passes `OSImageStreamRHEL9`.| **Estimated code review effort:** 3 (Moderate) | ~20 minutes **Suggested labels:** `do-not-merge/work-in-progress` **Suggested reviewers:** `cheesesashimi`, `ptalgulk01` ### Sequence Diagram(s) ```mermaid sequenceDiagram participant cloneMachineSet participant RHCOSHandler participant getRHCOSImagesInfo cloneMachineSet->>RHCOSHandler: resolve base image using version and stream RHCOSHandler->>getRHCOSImagesInfo: fetch stream-specific image metadata getRHCOSImagesInfo-->>RHCOSHandler: return image information RHCOSHandler-->>cloneMachineSet: return base image or URL ```
